_help: One file per nation: data/formations/<prefix>_formation_data.json, with the same prefix as the unit file (us, ussr, wgermany ...).
nation: exactly the nation name used in the unit file (American, Soviet, WestGerman, British ...).
Formations can be made and changed in the program (main menu > Formations), which rewrites this file.
id: any unique text (used inside saved armies). name: shown in the army editor. hq: card id of the HQ unit.
division: the division the formation belongs to (e.g. 228th Guards); optional.
slots: the boxes of the formation diagram, in order. Each slot holds ONE unit.
id: unique inside the formation (used by 'exclusive'). group: the small heading of the box (Infantry, Armour, Red Banner ...).
compulsory: true = black box (must be filled to field the formation), false = grey box (optional).
units: the card ids that may fill the slot. Several ids = the OR choices of the diagram (pick one).
A unit that can be taken three times is three slots (see company_1 .. company_3).
exclusive: lists of slot ids of which only ONE may be filled, e.g. [["recon", "anti_tank"]] = recon OR anti-tank.
Units inside a formation do not count towards the unit limits of the army; the slots are the limit.
